_why: Her floor, 18 Nov 2026: "make sure 7 videos go out each week minimum for each channel" (coordinator's reading, decided: at least 7 PUBLIC videos per channel in any rolling 7 days AND at least one every day; Shorts count). Long-form targets stay as documented (How We Know 6 a week, Whisper Almanac per its lanes); Shorts fill the rest. Checked daily by loop/publish_floor.py in the 09:00 CT upload workflow, against YouTube's own public feed (never our ledger); the next days' schedule is read from the upload records. A breach is a red STOPPED email: a GitHub issue that @-mentions her, re-mentioned every day it lasts, closed by the first check that finds the floor met.
